item.html: Frequently Asked Questions About Roof Inspections
item.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Roof Inspections

items.q: How often should I get my roof inspected?
items.a: Industry standards suggest having your roof inspected at least once a year, as well as immediately following any severe weather events involving high winds or hail.

items.q: What exactly do you look for during an inspection?
items.a: We evaluate the structural integrity of the roof deck, the condition of the shingles, all complex drainage areas (valleys, gutters), and scrutinize every inch of flashing around vents and chimneys.
Yes! We offer free, no-obligation visual inspections for homeowners to help them understand the health of their roofing system.

items.q: Can this inspection help with my insurance policy?
items.a: Absolutely. Providing a clean bill of health for your roof can assist with your insurance policy. If we find storm damage, our report serves as the foundation for filing a successful claim.
